name: SpongeVanilla
author: support@cinammon.net
description: SpongeVanilla is the implementation of the Sponge API on top of Vanilla Minecraft.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# SpongeVanilla Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
apk add --no-cache curl jq

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Adding .jar when not ending with .jar
if [ "${SERVER_JARFILE##*.}" != "jar" ]; then
    SERVER_JARFILE="${SERVER_JARFILE}.jar"
fi

echo "Querying SpongePowered dl-api v2..."
if [ -z "${SV_VERSION}" ] || [ "${SV_VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ "${SV_VERSION}" = "recommended" ]; then
    VERSION_ID=$(curl -sL "https://dl-api.spongepowered.org/v2/groups/org.spongepowered/artifacts/spongevanilla/versions?limit=1" | jq -r '.artifacts | keys[0]')
elif echo "${SV_VERSION}" | grep -q '\.'; then
    VERSION_ID=$(curl -sL "https://dl-api.spongepowered.org/v2/groups/org.spongepowered/artifacts/spongevanilla/versions?tags=minecraft:${SV_VERSION}&limit=1" | jq -r '.artifacts | keys[0]')
    if [ -z "${VERSION_ID}" ] || [ "${VERSION_ID}" = "null" ]; then
        VERSION_ID=$(curl -sL "https://dl-api.spongepowered.org/v2/groups/org.spongepowered/artifacts/spongevanilla/versions?limit=1" | jq -r '.artifacts | keys[0]')
    fi
else
    VERSION_ID="${SV_VERSION}"
fi

echo "Selected SpongeVanilla version: ${VERSION_ID}"
SV_DL_LINK=$(curl -sL "https://dl-api.spongepowered.org/v2/groups/org.spongepowered/artifacts/spongevanilla/versions/${VERSION_ID}" | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.classifier=="universal") | .downloadUrl')

if [ -z "${SV_DL_LINK}" ] || [ "${SV_DL_LINK}" = "null" ]; then
    echo "Universal build not found, checking primary artifact..."
    SV_DL_LINK=$(curl -sL "https://dl-api.spongepowered.org/v2/groups/org.spongepowered/artifacts/spongevanilla/versions/${VERSION_ID}" | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.classifier=="") | select(.extension=="jar") | .downloadUrl')
fi

echo "Downloading SpongeVanilla from ${SV_DL_LINK}..."
curl -sSL -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${SV_DL_LINK}"

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
    echo "Downloading MC server.properties"
    curl -sSL -o server.properties https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkervcp/eggs/master/game_eggs/minecraft/java/server.properties
fi

echo "Install for SpongeVanilla is complete"
